browserScope: Each format: 66 existing scheduler cases across two cores/three engines, 24 delayed real Worker lifetime cases across two cores/old-new plugins/two modes/three engines, and 12 native timing cases on the candidate core. Timing contains six CPU-block diagnostics, not no-loss acceptance; async candidate cases require all rows and serial callbacks, fixed published cases retain the missing middle row.
failureExplanation: Controlled red: three actual defects (sampling RAF absent, missed middle row, delayed visible expiry). Native red: candidate missed middle plus an invalid serial assertion against the published known duplicate play/playing loop; serial assertion limited to candidate, published missing-middle assertion retained. First integration: 65/66 passed; one historical internal RAF=0 expectation updated to RAF=1 with explicit no-second-callback assertion.
remaining: PKG-DANMUKU-07 sustained native load/resource and Mask boundary acceptance
Actual device and release review gates
